verdict.rationale: While the root /llms.txt 404s, the docs subdomain serves a proper agent-oriented llms.txt index at rive.app/docs/llms.txt covering all doc pages as raw markdown, and every docs page is fetchable as .md with a pointer to that index, confirming an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs successfully. Missing for 10: a canonical root-level llms.txt (only the /docs/ path works), and no independent (non-probe) corroboration of agent usage.
